title: TridiVision
hero_desc: The vision software for every Bigframe camera: 2D, 3D and deep learning in one graphical environment.
intro: A graphical dataflow environment: place tools on a canvas, link their parameters, run them and read the results. Standard tasks need no code; custom operators can be added for the rest. The same environment handles 2D images, height maps and point clouds, runs deep-learning models trained in its AI Training edition, builds the operator screen and drives third-party 2D and 3D cameras alongside the Bigframe camera. Results, signals and robot paths go to the PLC, MES or robot.
caption_fig1: Solder-ball inspection — every ball numbered and measured on the canvas
caption_fig2: Pin inspection — height of every pin and its pass/fail state in the operator screen
fn_2d_desc: Positioning, measurement, defect detection, OCR and code reading, image processing, calibration.
fn_zmap_desc: Height, step, flatness and coplanarity, distance and angle on height maps; multi-camera stitching.
fn_cloud_desc: Recognition and pose, robot path planning, point-cloud processing and export.
fn_dl_desc: Classification, segmentation, detection; AI Runtime runs the models, AI Training trains them.
fn_comm_desc: PLC, MES and robot interfaces; results, signals and robot paths.
fn_hmi_desc: HMI designer: build the operator screen by drag and drop.
